indicator_definition: Total tax revenue including social contributions as a percentage of GDP. Reflects the capacity of governments to mobilise domestic resources. Data compiled by Eurostat from national accounts.
rationale: Adequate domestic resource mobilisation finances sustainable development. Progress means a stable and sufficient tax revenue base for public services.
methodology_characteristics: Data compiled from national accounts under ESA 2010. Includes all compulsory levies and social contributions. Published annually by Eurostat.
indicator_name: Tax revenue as share of GDP
graph_title: Tax revenue as share of GDP
